units.source_text: 这天晚上源氏公子态度十分认真，

en.t: That evening, Prince Genji was extremely earnest in his manner,

units.source_text: 他强迫槿姬答复：“只求你不用侍女传达，

en.t: and he pressed Princess Asagao for an answer: "I only ask that you not send it through a lady-in-waiting,

units.source_text: 亲口回答我一句话。

en.t: but answer me one word with your own lips.

units.source_text: 即使你说讨厌我，我也可从此死了这条心。”

en.t: Even if you say you hate me, I can give up this hope from now on."

units.source_text: 槿姬想道：“从前，我和他都年轻，

en.t: Princess Asagao thought, "In the past, when he and I were both young,

units.source_text: 一时做错了事，世人也会原谅。

en.t: even if we had made a mistake in a moment of weakness, people might have forgiven us.

units.source_text: 加之父亲也看重他。

en.t: Besides, my father also held him in high regard.

units.source_text: 那时我尚且认为不当，觉得可耻，

en.t: Even then I thought it improper and felt it would be shameful,

units.source_text: 其后一直坚决拒绝。

en.t: and afterward I continued to refuse him firmly.

units.source_text: 何况现在事隔多时，年龄早已过期，

en.t: How much more so now, after so much time has passed and my age is long past that season,

units.source_text: 已经不是那种岁数了，

en.t: when I am no longer of such an age,

units.source_text: 岂可亲口和他答话？”

en.t: how could I possibly speak with him directly?"

units.source_text: 她的心坚定不动。

en.t: Her heart remained firm and unmoved.

units.source_text: 源氏公子大失所望，满怀怨恨。

en.t: Prince Genji was deeply disappointed and filled with resentment.

units.source_text: 然而槿姬也不愿过分强硬，以致失礼于人，

en.t: Yet Princess Asagao also did not wish to be so unyielding that she would be discourteous,

units.source_text: 她照旧叫侍女传言。

en.t: so, as usual, she had a lady-in-waiting convey her words.

units.source_text: 但这反而使得源氏公子焦急。

en.t: But this only made Prince Genji more impatient.

units.source_text: 此时夜已甚深，寒风凛冽，光景实甚凄凉。

en.t: By then the night was very deep, the cold wind was piercing, and the scene was truly desolate.

units.source_text: 源氏公子感伤之极，两泪夺眶而出。

en.t: Prince Genji was overcome with sorrow, and tears welled from both his eyes.

units.source_text: 举袖拭泪，姿态优美动人。

en.t: He raised his sleeve to wipe them away, a gesture graceful and moving.

units.source_text: 他吟诗道：

en.t: He then recited a poem:
